root_cause: checkout-service is CPU-bound: its request loop cannot keep up, so every outbound call waits in the service itself and all dependencies appear slower at once

evidence.supports: calls toward payment-service slow by a comparable factor, in the same window - the delay is upstream of both

evidence.observation: stayed at 0.0 for the whole window
evidence.supports: nothing queues on the database pool, so the wait is not I/O on postgres

evidence.observation: went 89.4 to 97.4, inside its baseline range
evidence.supports: the process is not growing - the pressure is on the CPU, not on memory

ruled_out: one slow dependency - both p95_by_dependency series rose together, x2.39 and x1.82; a single slow dependency moves only its own
connection pool exhaustion - db_pool_usage stayed at 0.0, where an exhausted pool climbs toward 1
memory leak - memory_mb stayed inside its baseline range and cache_entries stayed at 0, both among the metrics that stayed normal
